definitions.explanation: The tenth month of the year. Autumn is in full swing with pleasant weather and autumn foliage.

examples.japanese: {十月|じゅうがつ}は{秋|あき}です。
{十月|じゅうがつ}の{天気|てんき}は{気持|きも}ちがいいです。
examples.english: The weather in October is pleasant.

examples.japanese: {十月|じゅうがつ}に{紅葉|こうよう}を{見|み}に{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I'll go see the autumn leaves in October.

examples.japanese: {十月|じゅうがつ}になると、{朝|あさ}と{夜|よる}は{涼|すず}しくなります。
examples.english: When October comes, mornings and evenings get cool.

examples.japanese: {十月|じゅうがつ}は{旅行|りょこう}にいい{季節|きせつ}なので、{京都|きょうと}に{行|い}こうと{思|おも}っています。
examples.english: October is a good season for travel, so I'm thinking of going to Kyoto.

notes: October is literally 'month ten.' It's considered one of the most pleasant months in Japan with comfortable temperatures and beautiful autumn colors. Many school and company sports days (運動会) are held in October.
